name: nest_home_control
description: Read or set Nest thermostat state. Pass any combination of state fields (mode, target_temperature, fan_mode, eco_enabled) in one call to set them. Omit all fields to read current state.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Bare uppercase one of: HEAT, COOL, HEATCOOL, OFF.

inputs.name: fan_mode
inputs.description: Bare uppercase one of: ON, AUTO, OFF.

inputs.name: eco_enabled
inputs.description: Eco-mode toggle. true to enable, false to disable.

inputs.name: device_id
inputs.description: Target a specific thermostat. Omit for default.

inputs.name: get_status
inputs.description: Verbose read flag. Equivalent to passing no fields.
